question: Can balanced clustered retrieval recover dense tied-head decisions with materially lower physical H200 cost than dense 12xM32 and the ideal grouped-exact baseline?

representation.balance: exact equal token count per cluster
representation.candidate_scores: exact dense BF16-weight dot-product oracle restricted to tokens in selected clusters

representation.runtime_centroids: exact FP32 mean of original 5376-D embedding rows, modeled as BF16 storage
